title: How a massage studio increased leads from maps
excerpt: How a massage studio improved its listing, reviews, and regular updates to receive more enquiries from maps.
seoTitle: Lead growth in a massage studio — LocalOS case
seoDescription: Case study of the local business: how the massage studio strengthened the card on the maps, reviews and content to receive more applications.
situation: The studio had a good rating, but the card looked general: there were few specific services, there was a lack of photos of the result and regular updates.
actions: divided services according to demand scenarios
launched regular news about procedures and promotions
result: The card began to respond better to specific requests, and the owner received an understandable rhythm of updates without manual routine.

body.title: What worked best
body.body: Clear service descriptions, recent reviews, and relevant photos made the biggest difference. Clients could quickly understand which treatment to choose and what made the studio different.

title: How a salon gained new bookings from maps
excerpt: A beauty salon clarified its services, improved review handling, and built a practical plan for its business listing.
seoTitle: How the salon received new entries from maps — LocalOS case
seoDescription: Beauty salon case study: how a clearer listing, services, reviews, and photos helped generate more bookings from maps.
situation: The salon depended on repeat customers, while new customers from maps arrived irregularly. Services were listed, but the choice was difficult to understand.
actions: rewrote the description of the card for search
added a content plan for short news
result: The card has become clearer for a new client: services, trust, prices and a reason to sign up here are visible.

body.title: Takeaway
body.body: For the salon, not only the beauty of the card is important, but also the clarity of choice. The client should quickly understand which service is right for him and what to do next.

title: How a small café attracted more weekday guests
excerpt: A café near offices reorganized its listing around breakfast, lunch, and takeaway coffee, making it easier for nearby guests to choose it.
seoTitle: Cafe case study: more guests on weekdays — LocalOS
seoDescription: LocalOS case study for cafes: how updating the card, menu, photos and reviews helped to increase the flow of guests on weekdays.
situation: The café was visible in branded search, but rarely appeared for nearby needs such as breakfast, business lunch, and takeaway coffee.
actions: divided the card into understandable visit scenarios
added photos of dishes and updated the description of popular items
collected weekly monitoring of card updates
result: The card has become clearer for the office audience nearby. Guests were more likely to build a route, call, and leave reviews after their visit.

body.title: Why it worked
body.body: The cafe ceased to look like just a dot on the map. The card has specific reasons to enter: breakfast before work, lunch nearby, takeaway coffee.

body.title: What can be repeated
items: maintain menus and photos as a living display unit
once a week to check reviews and questions
highlight scenarios in which the customer chooses a nearby cafe
